candidates.change_summary: Change the assignment to winnersPerPeriod to require admin and set winnersPerPeriod to newWinnersPerPeriodAmount + 1 (off-by-one), altering the stored value.
Change the assignment to winnersPerPeriod to subtract 1 from the provided value (off-by-one), altering the stored value.
